source: Issue #205: refresh captures without reading the unused bounding rectangle between them.
notes: Every trade is 0.01 BTC at its base row's lower edge, so row r contains r*1.25 USDT per trade. Sparse captures straddle the exact 4096-column bound. The dense profile is 3000 columns by 8 rows: 24000 cells, while 2500 columns by 8 rows is exactly the production 20000-cell agent limit. Mixed captures use n=1,m=1, including a half-time and half-price region. All expected regions and bounds come from this geometry; no generator or fake aggregation supplies the expected outcomes.
